_khuon.muc_dich: Kho văn bản ngắn của 🔎 Bến Dò Tin (Thành phố TOEIC): luyện câu hỏi Part 7 (trừ từ gần nghĩa, chèn câu). Mỗi văn bản 60–120 từ kiểu Part 7 (e-mail, thông báo, quảng cáo, tin nhắn, bài báo ngắn, biểu mẫu), 3 câu hỏi. Không chép đề ETS / đề trong app; người, công ty hư cấu.

cu_dan.P: Mục đích: Why was the e-mail written? What is the purpose of…? (đọc câu đầu / câu yêu cầu)
cu_dan.C: Chi tiết: When / Where / How much / What… (dò từ khoá của câu hỏi trong bài)
cu_dan.K: Đúng–Sai: What is indicated / stated / true about…? What is NOT mentioned? (đối chiếu từng phương án)
cu_dan.Y: Suy luận: What is suggested / most likely…? What does X mean when he writes…? (đọc kỹ chỗ liên quan, không có chữ y nguyên)

_khuon.dinh_dang: { id 'bt-NN', kind: loại văn bản tiếng Anh như đề (E-mail, Notice, Advertisement, Text message chain, Article, Memo, Web page, Form, Invitation, Review), t: văn bản (mỗi câu kết thúc bằng . ! ?; tin nhắn mỗi dòng 'Tên (giờ): …', xuống dòng bằng \n), qs: [ { ty: P|C|K|Y, q: câu hỏi tiếng Anh, a: đáp án, w: [3 phương án sai], ev: một đoạn ≥ 20 ký tự chép NGUYÊN VĂN từ đúng MỘT câu của t chứa bằng chứng (câu NOT: câu chứa đáp án đúng, tức điều KHÔNG được nhắc thì ev là câu gần nhất liên quan), why: tiếng Việt ≤ 40 từ, vi: dịch câu hỏi } ] }
_khuon.luat_soan: Đáp án diễn đạt lại (không chép nguyên văn cụm từ của bài); 3 phương án sai cùng loại, hợp lẽ thường, chỉ bài mới phân biệt được; đáp án không luôn là phương án dài nhất. Mỗi văn bản 3 câu hỏi khác loại khi được; câu hỏi theo thứ tự xuất hiện trong bài.

items.t:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,
Thank you for ordering from Brightline Office Supply. Unfortunately, the ergonomic chairs you requested are out of stock until March 12. We can ship the rest of your order today and send the chairs as soon as they arrive. Alternatively, we can hold the entire order and deliver everything together. Please reply by Friday to let us know which option you prefer. As an apology for the delay, shipping on this order will be free.
Best regards,
Tom Becker, Customer Service

qs.a: To explain a problem with part of an order
w: To confirm that a payment was received
To advertise a new line of furniture
To request a change to a delivery address
qs.ev: the ergonomic chairs you requested are out of stock until March 12
qs.why: Thư báo ghế đặt mua đang hết hàng tới 12/3, tức một phần đơn hàng có vấn đề.
qs.vi: Vì sao ông Becker viết thư cho bà Alvarez?

qs.q: What is Ms. Alvarez asked to do by Friday?
qs.a: Choose how the order will be sent
w: Visit a store to pick up chairs
qs.ev: Please reply by Friday to let us know which option you prefer
qs.why: Bà được đề nghị trả lời trước thứ Sáu để chọn một trong hai cách giao hàng.
qs.vi: Bà Alvarez được đề nghị làm gì trước thứ Sáu?

qs.a: It will be delivered at no extra cost.
w: It includes a discount on chairs.
qs.ev: shipping on this order will be free
qs.why: Câu cuối nói phí vận chuyển của đơn này được miễn, tức giao không mất thêm tiền.
qs.vi: Điều gì được nêu về đơn hàng?

items.t:
Attention, Harbor Tower Tenants
The main elevator will be closed for inspection on Saturday, June 8, from 8:00 A.M. to 2:00 P.M. During this time, please use the service elevator at the rear of the building. Deliveries scheduled for that morning should be moved to the afternoon if possible. The building office on the ground floor will be open as usual. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience.
Harbor Tower Management

Dear Mr. Haddad,
I am writing to invite you to interview for the logistics coordinator position at Norwick Freight. The interview will take place on Tuesday, April 16, at our Dover Street office. Please plan to arrive twenty minutes early to complete a short safety form. You will meet with our operations director and a member of the human resources team. If the date does not suit you, call Priya Nair at 555-0148 to arrange another time.
Sincerely,
Glenn Walsh, Human Resources

To announce a new office location for the company
To explain a change to safety rules

Notice to All Library Members
Beginning next month, the Oakmont Public Library will extend its evening hours. The building will stay open until 9:00 P.M. on Mondays through Thursdays. To cover the longer schedule, two new part-time librarians will join the staff in May. Weekend hours will not change. Members who wish to suggest new programs may leave a note at the front desk or send an e-mail to the director.

qs.a: To announce a change in operating hours

Lakeside Cycle Rentals
Explore Lake Merritt on two wheels! Our shop offers mountain bikes, city bikes, and electric bikes by the hour or by the day. Every rental includes a helmet, a lock, and a free trail map. Groups of five or more receive a 15 percent discount when they reserve online. We are located beside the marina and open daily from 8:00 A.M. until sunset. Visit www.lakesidecycle.example to book today.

items.t:
Greenfield Market to Open Second Location
Greenfield Market, a family-owned grocery store known for local produce, will open a second branch on Pine Avenue next Saturday. Owner Carla Jimenez said the new store will be twice the size of the original and will include a small café. About thirty residents have already been hired to work there. "Our customers asked for more space and more parking," Ms. Jimenez said. The first store will remain open during the expansion.

To announce a job fair for local grocery workers
To describe changes in parking laws

Our garden gives local residents a place to grow their own vegetables and herbs. Plots are available for an annual fee of $40, and tools may be borrowed from the shed at no charge. Members are asked to volunteer four hours each season to help with shared tasks. A waiting list is currently in place because all 60 plots are rented. Local Bakery Wins National Award
Maple Street Bakery was named the best small bakery in the country at the National Food Industry Awards on Sunday. Owner Hassan Demir founded the business eleven years ago with just two employees. Today the bakery has 18 staff members and supplies bread to more than forty restaurants. Mr. Demir credited his team's dedication for the honor. "We still make everything by hand," he said.

qs.ev: Maple Street Bakery was named the best small bakery in the country at the National Food Industry Awards on Sunday.

To: All Managers
From: Sofia Reyes, Human Resources
Date: March 14
Subject: Performance reviews
Annual performance reviews will begin on April 1. Each manager should meet individually with every team member for about thirty minutes. Review forms are available on the company intranet and must be completed before each meeting. Late submissions will delay salary adjustments for the entire department.
